tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO₂) with acidemia (low arterial pH), suggestive of respiratory failure. There is mild leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, and thrombocytopenia, with relative monocytosis and basophilia. Hematocrit is slightly elevated, and MCHC is low. Alkaline phosphatase is mildly increased, while ALT is low. Other parameters are within normal limits. Findings are consistent with acute or chronic hypoxic respiratory disease and possible bone marrow suppression; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
